figurative_meaning_en: face stained with infamy, shameless, brazen
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বেহায়া কালামুখ আর দেখিয়ো না।
সে কালামুখের মতো কাজ করে যায়, কোনো লজ্জা নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't look at this shameless black-faced person anymore.
He acts like a brazen-faced person, with no shame at all.
note: The idiom draws from the cultural imagery of a face blackened by soot or shame, common in rural and semi-urban Bengali contexts.
